programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Basing itself on her letters and diaries, her compositions, and on accounts from musicians who have intensively studied her music, this 2019 documentary offers a multi-angled perspective on Clara Schumann.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices - The legacy of Farinelli
programme.desc: The documentary 'Heavenly Voices – The Legacy of Farinelli' (2012) tells us the story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries. In this documentary, countertenors Max Emanuel Cenčić, Philippe Jaroussky, Andreas Scholl, Franco Fagioli, and Jochen Kowalski discuss Baroque-era operatic entertainment. 'Heavenly Voices' is a film by Gino Pennacchi (writer) and Alessandro Scillitani (director).

programme.title: Roberto Giordano plays Brahms and Beethoven
programme.desc: Roberto Giordano plays the Six Pieces for Piano, op. 118 of Brahms, as well as the famous Moonlight Sonata and Sonata No. 31, op. 110 of Beethoven. This concert was recorded at Villa Visconti Borromeo Litta in Lainate in 2017.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, Martha Argerich performs Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15 with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt. Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36, is also on the program. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Schumann - Humoreske, Op. 20
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birthday, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op. 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece’s title refers to humor as an emotional state. Schumann took his inspiration from German Romantic writer Jean Paul, who defines humor as “an infinity of contrast”, “a setting of the small world beside the great”, and where “a kind of laughter results which contains pain and greatness”.

programme.title: Bach Concerto & Mendelssohn Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: The legendary Sir András Schiff takes on the dual role of conductor and soloist in this special concert with the Freixenet Symphony Orchestra of the Reina Sofía School of Music. The program opens with Johann Sebastian Bach’s Keyboard Concerto No. 5 in F minor, BWV 1056, with Schiff himself at the piano. The concert concludes with Felix Mendelssohn’s magnificent ‘Italian’ Symphony No. 4.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Kirill Karabits conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler’s Symphony No. 4. Soloist is soprano Lucy Crowe. Recorded on December 8th, 2021.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 8, also known as the "Symphony of a Thousand," is a monumental choral epic composed in 1906 that requires an enormous ensemble of soloists, choruses, and a massive orchestra to perform its vast musical tapestry.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Rachmaninov & Gershwin: Rhapsodies
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia and acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky are conducted by Konstantin Khvatynets in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Unusual Orchestral Colors and Effects. The use of less common instruments and the fresh soundscapes Mahler creates, lead to a rich and unique listening experience.

programme.title: Schubert - Overture to Rosamunde (D. 644)
programme.desc: Andreas Spering conducts Philharmonie Zuidnederland in a performance of "Overture Rosamunde" (D. 644), by Franz Schubert (1797-1828). Recorded in Muziekgebouw Eindhoven, The Netherlands in 2015.

programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. In the documentary ‘Hans van Manen – Moving to Music’ (2022), Van Manen reflects on his life, work, and the inspirations behind ballets charged with drama and eroticism. The film features excerpts from some of his most successful ballets.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Music in the air
programme.desc: The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015. To commemorate this, renowned film maker Reiner E. Moritz produced the documentary 'Music in the air' to shed light on the history of classical music on television.

programme.title: Beethoven - Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20
programme.desc: The soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra present two septets in this entertaining 2020 concert, recorded at Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland. The concert opens with Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 11 in D major, K. 251, also known as the ‘Nannerl-Septet’. This is followed by Ludwig van Beethoven’s Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20.

programme.title: Chamber music by Haydn, Tchaikovsky and others
programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of ‘Preludio’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on April 30, 2024.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career. Only after WWII, Haskil’s fame began to take off and she finally enjoyed international recognition.

programme.title: Donizetti - L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza conducts the Orchestra Gli Originali and the Coro Donizetti Opera in a performance of Geatano Donizetti’s comic opera L’elisir d’amore (‘The Elixer of Love’, 1832). Directed by Frederic Wake-Walker, this 2021 production is unique as it features the complete, original score as reconstructed by Alberto Zedda based on Donizetti’s autographs. In addition, the orchestra plays on historical instruments to recreate the sound of Donizetti’s orchestra. Among the soloists are Caterina Sala (Adina), Javier Camarena (Nemorino), Florian Sempey (Belcore), Roberto Frontali (Dulcamara), Anaïs Mejías (Giannetta), and Manuel Ferreira (Master of ceremonies). This performance was part of the Donizetti Opera Festival, recorded at Teatro Donizetti in Bergamo, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Von Weber - Overture to Oberon
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world’s finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo’s magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 15, Op. 132
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 6 in B-flat major, Op. 18 No. 6; and String Quartet No. 15 in A minor, Op. 132. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 24, 2020.

programme.title: Britten - War Requiem
programme.desc: Paul McCreesh conducts the Orquesta Gulbenkian and Coro Infantil da Academia de Música de Sana Cecília in a performance of Benjamin Britten’s War Requiem. Soloists are Tatiana Pavlovskaya (soprano), John Mark Ainsley (tenor) and Hanno Müller-Brachmann (bass).

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: Conducted by Andreas Spering, the South Netherlands Philharmonic performs Beethoven’s Sixth Symphony. Ludwig van Beethoven painted in his symphony the rustic idylls of a peasants’ picnic in the countryside, rife with murmuring brooks and a frightful thunderstorm.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: This ‘In Rehearsal’ episode features the Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen rehearsing Claude Debussy's Impressionistic orchestral piece La Mer with the Los Angeles Philharmonic at the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion of the Music Center of Los Angeles County. It gives a fascinating insight into Salonen’s rapport with his musicians and also into Debussy’s masterpiece.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry, the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame, plays Pierre Cochereau’s Boléro, Louis Vierne’s Carillon of Westminster and Scherzo from Symphony No. 2, Alexandre Guilmant’s Sonata No. 1, and more.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Schumann - Carnaval, Op. 9
programme.desc: Robert Schumann wrote Carnaval, Op. 9 in 1834–1835. It consists of 21 short pieces representing masked revelers at Carnival, a festival before Lent. Schumann gives musical expression to himself, his friends and colleagues, and characters from improvised Italian comedy (commedia dell'arte). Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program featuring Johannes Brahms’s Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81, and Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Jaeden Izik-Dzurko
programme.desc: Pianist Jaeden Izik-Dzurko (Canada, 1999) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Mahler's Symphony No. 6. The concert is Rattle's last time as chief conductor of the orchestra. On 14 November 1987, it was also the first work Rattle conducted when he debuted with the Berlin Philharmonic.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2, 'Resurrection'
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, ‘Resurrection’. Soprano Christiane Karg and alto Claudia Huckle are the soloists. Written between 1888 and 1894, this five-movement symphony is scored for a large orchestra, chorus, and soprano and alto soloists. Mahler explores themes of life, death, and resurrection throughout the symphony. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: Robert Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839. Bearing a dedication to Franz Liszt, it is one of Schumann's greatest works for solo piano, and a central work of the early Romantic period. Written in a loose sonata form, the first movement is rhapsodic and passionate, the middle movement is a grandiose rondo, and the finale is slow and meditative. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 21
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 4 in G major, BWV 1049.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?
programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband. This 2017 documentary gives a fascinating account of what happened to one this iconic piece of music right under the nose of the public. Filmmaker Fabien Caux-Lahalle underpins this investigative story with clips of the Boléro in various guises.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program includes Felix Mendelssohn’s concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides); Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist; and Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, recorded in De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2018. Alvaro Siviero is the soloist in Grieg's Piano Concerto No. 1.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works. Paganini’s Violin Concerto No. 1. is paired with Brahms’ dramatic symphonic debut, Symphony No.1. This exceptional performance features the dazzling virtuosity of violinist In Mo Yang, winner of the 2015 Paganini Competition.

programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta. The program ends with Brahms’s Symphony No. 3 in F major, Op. 90. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on December 4, 2017.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28. This episode of ‘In Rehearsal’ offers an intimate look at the dialogue between Mehta and the musicians as they explore Strauss’s tone poem together.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Symphony of Psalms
programme.desc: This live performance marks Fabio Luisi’s very first concert with the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in DR Koncerthuset, Copenhagen. Beethoven’s milestone Eroica symphony is paired with Stravinsky’s mighty Symphony of Psalms and Strauss’ virtuosic Don Juan.

programme.title: Busoni - Kultaselle, 10 Variations
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff.

programme.title: Mozart - Quintet for piano and winds, K. 452
programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, K. 452. This performance was recorded at Perugia’s Auditorium Santa Cecilia, Italy, on June 23, 2022.

programme.title: Vocal baroque works by Cavalli, Strozzi & Bembo
programme.desc: Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music. Argentinian soprano Mariana Flores presents the vocal works. This performance was recorded at the magnificent Église Notre-Dame of Sablé-sur-Sarthe, France, on August 26, 2020.

programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. On the program are Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K. 364, Mozart’s Sonata for violin and piano in E minor, K. 304, and Dmitri Shostakovich’s Chamber Symphony in C minor, Op. 110a.

programme.title: Music in the air
programme.desc: The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015. To commemorate this, renowned film maker Reiner E. Moritz produced the documentary 'Music in the air' to shed light on the history of classical music on television.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Marco Sollini, Salvatore Barbatano.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in this touching performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 9 in D major. Written in 1908-1909, it was the last symphony Mahler completed. Symphony No. 9 premiered on June 26, 1912, in Vienna, performed by the Vienna Philharmonic led by Bruno Walter. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Works by Smetana, Janáček, Suk and Dvořák
programme.desc: Musicians of the Reina Sofía School of Music pay tribute to the rich musical heritage of Czechia in this chamber concert. The program features works by Bedřich Smetana, Leoš Janáček, Josef Suk and Antonín Dvořák. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on November 28, 2024.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Basing itself on her letters and diaries, her compositions, and on accounts from musicians who have intensively studied her music, this 2019 documentary offers a multi-angled perspective on Clara Schumann.

programme.title: Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. This performance was recorded at the Budapest Music Center, Hungary, in September 2023.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. As an encore, Oganyan performs Der Bote (‘The Messenger’) by Ukrainian composer Valentin Silvestrov. This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Sleeping Beauty (2013)
programme.desc: Set to the magnificent compositions of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky, The Sleeping Beauty retells the classic fairy tale love story through sublime world class ice dancing, breathtaking high speed lifts and throws, awe-inspiring aerial gymnastics and fire effects in a choreography by the award-winning Tony Mercer, all in the enchanting setting of a theater stage. Performed by a cast of world class ice skaters, holding more than 300 competition medals between them, this wintery spin on one of the most famous fairy tales of all time enchants with creative and powerful story-telling, sumptuous sets, spectacular special effects and opulent costumes. Recorded 2013 at the Teatro Montecasino in Johannesburg, South Africa.

programme.title: Liszt - Elegies No. 1 and 2 (S. 130 & 131)
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Mahler's 9th Symphony captivates through its profound emotional depth and vulnerability, especially the breathtakingly beautiful and spiritually resonant Adagio that concludes the work, offering a profound sense of closure and transcendence.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices - The legacy of Farinelli
programme.desc: The documentary 'Heavenly Voices – The Legacy of Farinelli' (2012) tells us the story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries. In this documentary, countertenors Max Emanuel Cenčić, Philippe Jaroussky, Andreas Scholl, Franco Fagioli, and Jochen Kowalski discuss Baroque-era operatic entertainment. 'Heavenly Voices' is a film by Gino Pennacchi (writer) and Alessandro Scillitani (director).

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Cerón (bariton).

programme.title: Slatkin conducts Bolcom, Beethoven & Ravel
programme.desc: American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22. The composer completed the work in 1838. Of Schumann’s three piano sonatas, Piano Sonata No. 2 is performed and recorded most frequently.

programme.title: Von Weber - Der Freischütz
programme.desc: This unique production of Carl Maria von Weber’s 'Der Freischütz' was created to celebrate both the piece’s 200th premiere anniversary at Konzerthaus Berlin and the 200th anniversary of the famed concert hall itself. Christoph Eschenbach conducts Konzerthausorchester Berlin and Rundfunkchor Berlin in this 2021 performance.

programme.title: Ravel by Cherkaoui/Verbruggen
programme.desc: The Royal Ballet Flanders performs ballets on music by Ravel by choreographers Sidi Larbi Cherkaoui and Jeroen Verbruggen. The Symphonic Orchestra of the Opera Vlaanderen is conducted by Yannis Pouspourikas. Recorded in the Opera Antwerp, in 2016.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 6 and 15
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 6 in B-flat major, Op. 18 No. 6; and String Quartet No. 15 in A minor, Op. 132. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 24, 2020.

programme.title: Franck - Sonata for violin and piano
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 for chamber orchestra
programme.desc: As part of the ‘Da Camera’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, the Spanish Grupo Fundación Mutua Madrileña performs Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’, in an arrangement for chamber orchestra by conductor Francisco Alonso Serena. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on May 30, 2023.

programme.title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program includes Felix Mendelssohn’s concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides); Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist; and Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92.

programme.title: Mikhail Pletnev conducts Rimski-Korsakov
programme.desc: Russian conductor and pianist Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in performances of Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov's music. On the program are Suite for Orchestra after the opera 'The Legend of the Invisible City of Kitezh and the Maiden Fevroniya', and Musical Pictures for Orchestra from the opera 'The Tale of Tsar Saltan'.

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers - Live At Wolf Trap
programme.desc: Filmed in high definition on 25 July 2004 at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Virginia, Live At Wolf Trap captures The Doobie Brothers in fine form on a set that mixes classic hits with some rarely performed tracks.

programme.title: Bastille - Reading and Leeds Festival 2022

programme.desc: Filmed at The Moody Theater in Austin, Texas, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Coldplay featuring unforgettable version of their hits: "Viva La Vida", "Fix You", "Clocks" and many more….

programme.desc: Main Square Festival is a music festival that takes place in Arras, France, lasting three days.

programme.title: The Offspring - Rock AM
programme.desc: The Offspring is an American rock band from California. Originally formed under the name Manic Subsidal, the band's lineup consists of lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist Bryan Holland, bassist Todd Morse and lead guitarist Kevin Wasserman.

programme.title: Ed Sheeran - Live in London
programme.desc: Ed Sheeran manages to make a huge venue feel like an intimate setting. With only his guitar and his incredible vocal skills, Ed puts on a great performance in 2014 at the Roundhouse Art Centre, in London.

programme.title: Limp Bizkit - Live at Reading Festival
programme.desc: The Reading Festival are a pair of annual rock music festivals that take place in Reading and Leeds in England. The events take place simultaneously on the Friday, Saturday and Sunday of the August bank holiday weekend, sharing the same bill.

programme.title: Peter Gabriel - New Blood: Live in London
programme.desc: Filmed at the Hammersmith Apollo in March 2011, "New Blood - Live In London" captures Peter Gabriel performing live with the 46 piece New Blood Orchestra.

programme.title: Florence And The Machine - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd - Live From The Florida Theater
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-’nérd ‘Skin-’nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida.

programme.title: Ray Charles, Bo Diddley, James Brown & B.B. King - Legends of Rock and Roll
programme.desc: Filmed in Rome in 1989, this once-in-a-lifetime live performance features some of the most legendary performers in rock n' roll history, including B.B. King, Jerry Lee Lewis, Bo Diddley, Little Richard, Fats Domino, Ray Charles, and James Brown.

programme.title: Mötley Crüe - The End: Live In Los Angeles
programme.desc: The visually stunning and final concert of Mötley Crüe’s final tour, Mötley Crüe: The End was captured with 30 cameras in Ultra HD 4K in front of a sold out crowd of die hard Mötley Crüe fans.

programme.title: Jerry Lee Lewis - Jerry Lee Lewis and Friends
programme.desc: This concert, recorded at London's Hammersmith Apollo in 1989, features Lewis in performances of his classic tracks all delivered in his own inimitable way. Joining him on stage are a great list of guests including Van Morrison, Dave Edmunds, and more.

programme.title: Foo Fighters - Live in London 2011
programme.desc: Foo Fighters is one of the most popular bands in the world. In 2011 they were invited to participate in the iTunes Festival in London. On July 11, before a fully packed Roundhouse theater, the band gave their fans a concert of over two hours of music.

programme.title: Alabama Shakes - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: Mixing classic R&B vocals with a soulful blues-rock base, Alabama Shakes have taken garage rock and turned it on its head. Alabama Shakes takes the Austin City Limits stage for the second time in support of their newest album Sound & Color.

programme.title: Britney Spears - Live from London
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Britney Spears performs her hits including "Baby One More Time", "Oops! I Did It Again", "Toxic" and many more.

programme.title: Grace Mitchell - Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: The Cure - Eurockéennes 2012
programme.desc: The legendary rock band The Cure hits the stage at Eurockéennes in Belfort, in 2012.

programme.title: Hans Zimmer - Live in Prague
programme.desc: This concert was filmed on 7th May 2016 in Prague during Hans Zimmer's hugely successful European concert tour. Hans was accompanied by a band, orchestra and choir, 72 musicians in total, including guest guitarist Johnny Marr.

programme.title: Leon Bridges - Live in London 2015
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: Red Hot Chili Peppers - Live at Tokyo Dome 2023
programme.desc: Red Hot Chili Peppers celebrate the return of John Frusciante, who performs in Japan with the band for the first time in 16 years in 2023!

programme.title: Of Monsters and Men - Main Square Festival 2013
programme.desc: The Icelandic band Of Monsters and Men perform a fun and entertaining set in sunny Arras, France. The folk story-tellers hit all the right notes!

programme.title: Charli XCX - Reading & Leeds Festival 2022
programme.desc: The Reading and Leeds Festivals are a pair of music festivals that take place annually in the cities of Reading and Leeds in England. Featuring Charli XCX.

programme.title: Jethro Tull - Live at Montreux, 2003
programme.desc: Split into a semi-acoustic first half and a full on electric second half, the concert was a triumph combining newer songs such as “Dot Com”, “Pavane” and “Budapest” with classic favorites. Music video by Jethro Tull __© 2003 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Charlie Puth - Live in London 2015
programme.desc: Charlie Puth performs during the 2015 Apple Music Festival at The Roundhouse on September 20, 2015 in London, England.

programme.title: The Who - Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle.

programme.title: Pet Shop Boys - Live at Roskilde 2009
programme.desc: Filmed in Roskilde, Denmark, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Pet Shop Boys featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Always On My Mind', 'West End Girls' and many more.

programme.title: Nazareth - Homecoming - The Greatest Hits Live from Glasgow
programme.desc: Recorded Live at The Garage, Glasgow, in 2001, this intimate performance includes most of the bands classics such as 'Razamanaz', and 'Hair of The Dog', and more recent songs including 'When the Light Comes Down' from their album Boogaloo.

programme.title: Imagine Dragons - Live At The Moody Theater
programme.desc: Filmed at The Moody Theater, Texas, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Imagine Dragons featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Demons', 'Radioactive' and many more.

programme.title: Yes - Songs From Tsongas 35th Anniversary
programme.desc: "Songs From Tsongas" is a live performance from Yes' 35th Anniversary Tour in 2004, the last tour by the band to feature the classic line-up of Jon Anderson, Steve Howe, Chris Squire, Rick Wakeman and Alan White.

programme.title: The Black Keys - Live at Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Elton John - Live in London 2013
programme.desc: Filmed at the Roundhouse in London, this concert film will give fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Elton John performs his hits: "Tiny Dancer", "Rocket Man", "Your Song" and many more.

programme.title: Lady Gaga - Live in London 2013
programme.desc: Lady Gaga's performance at the iTunes Festival in London on September 1, 2013 marks the superstar's first full concert since the The Born This Way Ball.

programme.title: 2CELLOS - Live in London 2011
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Matchbox Twenty - Live in London 2012
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Matchbox Twenty performs their hits including "Bright Lights" , "Parade" , "You're So Real", and many more….

programme.title: Florence And The Machine - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Destiny's Child - Live in Atlanta
programme.desc: Destiny's Child: Live in Atlanta is a live video album of the American group Destiny's Child. This show was graded on July 15, 2005 in Atlanta at the Philips Arena.

programme.title: Jerry Lee Lewis - Jerry Lee Lewis and Friends
programme.desc: This concert, recorded at London's Hammersmith Apollo in 1989, features Lewis in performances of his classic tracks all delivered in his own inimitable way. Joining him on stage are a great list of guests including Van Morrison, Dave Edmunds, and more.

programme.title: Alabama and Friends - Live at the Ryman
programme.desc: Join superstar band Alabama, recorded at the historic Ryman Auditorium, featuring on stage collaborations with country's biggest stars: Luke Bryan, Jason Aldean, Trisha Yearwood, Florida Georgia Line, Jamey Johnson and the Eli Young Band.

programme.title: Céline Dion - That's Just The Woman In Me
programme.desc: That's Just the Woman in Me is an American television special by Canadian singer Celine Dion which was aired on CBS on February 15, 2008 and was recorded at the Wiltern Theater in Los Angeles, California.

programme.title: R.E.M. - Live in Milan 2008
programme.desc: Filmed at Arena Civica, Milan, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic R.E.M. featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Losing My Religion', 'Drive', 'Man On the Moon' and many more.

programme.title: Robert Plant - Live in London 2014
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Alice In Chains - Alice in Chains - Unplugged
programme.desc: In their first live concert in over 2 years (and possibly their last concert ever), Alternative/metal group Alice in Chains performs acoustically at MTV Unplugged. Includes acoustic versions of their hits.

programme.title: Linkin Park - Live in New York
programme.desc: Filmed at the Madison Square Garden in New York, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Linkin Park performs hits including "Numb", "In The End", "Bleed it Out" and many more.

programme.title: Interpol - Rock En Seine
programme.desc: Interpol is an American rock band from Manhattan, New York,[2] formed in 1997. Their original line-up consisted of Paul Banks, Daniel Kessler, Carlos Dengler and Greg Drudy.

programme.title: Alabama Shakes - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: Mixing classic R&B vocals with a soulful blues-rock base, Alabama Shakes have taken garage rock and turned it on its head. Alabama Shakes takes the Austin City Limits stage for the second time in support of their newest album Sound & Color.

programme.title: Paul McCartney - A MusiCaresTribute
programme.desc: The unmistakable Paul McCartney was honored as "Person of the Year" by MusiCares at a gala event that brought together several artists to celebrate the Beatles' victorious career.

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the world famous Circus Krone in Munich, this AC/DC concert from June 17, 2003 features standout performances of "Rock N Roll Damnation" and "What's Next To The Moon" and more.

programme.title: Radiohead - The King of Limbs: Live from the Basement
programme.desc: The King of Limbs: Live from the Basement is a 2011 live video album by the English alternative rock band Radiohead, performing their eighth album, The King of Limbs (2011).

programme.title: ZZ Top - Live at Montreux
programme.desc: ZZ Top has made a number of visits to Montreux and this concert from 2013 is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances. The set list blends tracks from early seventies through their eighties blockbuster period and up to their most recent release. Music video by ZZ Top __© 2013 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Rod Stewart - Live at Hyde Park
programme.desc: Experience the legendary Rod Stewart as he closes Radio 2's Annual Festival In A Day with a memorable performance in September 2015 at London's Hyde Park.

programme.title: BLACKPINK - The Show
programme.desc: The Show opened with "Kill This Love", following a video featuring sights of dark and empty cities around the world.[9] Apart from live performances it also included several pre-recorded tracks.

programme.title: WALK THE MOON - Live in London 2012
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Walk the Moon performs their hits including "Shiver Shiver", "Next in Line", "Anna Sun" and many more.

programme.title: James Taylor - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Galletas de Navidad
programme.desc: Un gran coglomerado compra una fábrica de galletas, y mandan de ejecutiva a Hannah a que cierre la fábrica. Lo que parecía una simple tarea se complica cuando conoce al dueño de la fábrica, quien desea mantener la fábrica en la ciudad.

programme.title: Rescatando la Navidad
programme.desc: Sin ser consciente de ello, Erin desea que no exista la Navidad, pero Sam interviene para ayudarla a recuperar la festividad.

programme.title: Hollywood on Set
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Star Wars: Episodio VIII Te mostramos el backstage del set de: Star Wars Episodio VIII - Los últimos jedi, Esto recién comienza y Aprendiendo a vivir.

programme.title: Hollywood on Set
programme.desc: S1 E6 — The Post: Los oscuros secretos del Pentágono / Bright / 12 valientesTe mostramos el set y todo el desarrollo tras bambalinas de las peliculas: The Post: Los oscuros secretos del Pentágono, Bright y 12 valientes.

programme.title: Hollywood on Set
programme.desc: S1 E7 — Operación Red Sparrow / Así es la vida / Círculo de mentirasVamos detrás de las bambalinas, de los sets de Hollywood, en las peliculas: Operación Red Sparrow, Así es la vida y Círculo de mentiras.

programme.title: Misterio en Mistletoe Lane
programme.desc: Recién llegados a la ciudad, Heidi Wicks y sus hijos Annie y Garrett descubren un misterio navideño en su casa histórica. El historiador y personal de mantenimiento local David ayuda en el camino y encuentra su propia conexión sorprendente.

programme.title: Navigating Christmas
programme.desc: Cuando el ex marido de Heidi decepciona a su hijo, quien debía visitarlo en Navidad, busca un lugar donde puedan irse juntos. Encuentra alojamiento en un pintoresco y antiguo faro que debe ser decorado para las celebraciones de Navidad.

programme.title: Mrs. Miracle y la alegría de la Navidad
programme.desc: Tres hermanos regresan a casa en Navidad para honrar los deseos de su difunta abuela y, con la ayuda de la magia de Mrs. Miracle, resuelven conflictos familiares mientras uno reaviva un romance pasado.

programme.title: The Gift of Peace
programme.desc: Después de la muerte de su marido, Traci, una cristiana devota, pierde la fe. En su segunda Navidad sin él visita un grupo de apoyo en busca de consuelo e inspiración.

programme.title: Creando la Navidad
programme.desc: Harper, una maestra y aspirante a ilustradora, está deseando tener una oportunidad como dibujante, tiene que trabajar con Caleb, un exigente escritor de cuentos para niños cuya fama está en declive.

programme.title: El desfile navideño
programme.desc: Jessica está emocionada por encargarse de la organización del desfile navideño de su ciudad en Nueva Inglaterra. Cuando la persona encargada de interpretar a Santa se enferma, deberá encontrar un reemplazo, aunque este no esté dispuesto.

programme.title: Crashing Through the Snow
programme.desc: Durante la celebración de Navidad, Sam le propone a Maggie que se unan para evitar que su hermana tenga una Navidad perfecta. Sin embargo, ninguno de los dos está preparado para los desafíos que les aguardan como familia ensamblada.

programme.title: El duodécimo día de Navidad
programme.desc: Dos diseñadores de juegos aparentemente incompatibles se unen para crear una búsqueda del tesoro romántica por toda la ciudad con tema "Los doce días de Navidad".

programme.title: Cayendo como copos de nieve
programme.desc: Una fotógrafa decidida a completar su exhibición capturando una fotografía poco común de un copo de nieve de 12 lados, solicita la ayuda de un amigo de la infancia y se embarcan en una misión que nunca olvidarán.

programme.title: Navidad en Alaska
programme.desc: Dos periodistas que compiten por el mismo ascenso quedan atrapados juntos en la nevada Alaska después de que su avión se vea obligado a realizar un aterrizaje de emergencia. Se ven envueltos en un romance navideño totalmente inesperado.

programme.title: Parejas de Navidad
programme.desc: Esta Navidad, Olivia Hayes trabaja de encubierto para darle a sus lectores una reseña a fondo (y cínica) de un evento anual de enorme éxito, el Mistletoe Match, que encuentra parejas en la época de Navidad.

programme.title: Milagro en Belén, Pensilvania
programme.desc: Justo antes de Navidad, Mary Ann adopta una niña para criarla sola. Ella y el bebé pasan la Navidad atrapados en Bethlehem, Pensilvania, debido al mal tiempo. Su única opción es quedarse con Joe, el hermano del posadero.

programme.title: El tren navideño de las sorpresas
programme.desc: Un periodista se embarca en un viaje en tren de travesía en Navidad sin tener idea de que este viaje lo llevará al terreno accidentado de su propio corazón.

programme.title: Conexión navideña
programme.desc: Sydney es una azafata a quien le asignan cuidar a Leah, una menor que viaja sola. Luego de que es entregada a su padre, Sydney encuentra un paquete que Leah dejó olvidado y se lo lleva. Al hacerlo, el padre la invita a pasar las fiestas.

programme.title: Hollywood on Set
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Un viaje en el tiempo / Los extraños: cacería nocturna / Pablo, apóstol de CristoTe mostramos todo lo que pasó tras bambalinas en las películas: Un viaje en el tiempo, los extraños: cacería nocturna y Pablo, apóstol de Cristo.

programme.title: Hollywood on Set
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Gringo: se busca vivo o muerto / Un lugar en silencio / Yo soy SimónTe mostramos el detrás de escena de las películas: Gringo, se busca vivo o muerto, Un lugar en silencio y Yo soy Simón.

programme.title: Hollywood on Set
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Jurassic World: El reino caído / Sexy por accidente / Traffik: Red de peligroTe mostramos el detrás de escena de las películas: Jurassic World: El reino caído, Sexy por accidente y Traffik: Red de peligro.

programme.title: Buenos días Navidad
programme.desc: Dos presentadores de televisión competidores viajan a un pequeño pueblo durante Navidad. Mientras fingen que se llevan bien por el sobrellevar las apariencias, luego descubren que se parecen más de lo que pensaban.

programme.title: Es la época de la alegría
programme.desc: En busca de un ángulo nuevo en su nuevo libro sobre las relaciones, Merry se dirige a Vermont cubierto de nieve. Allí encuentra una nueva perspectiva y alegría navideña con el carismático trabajador humanitario, Chris.

programme.title: Navidad en el lago
programme.desc: La diseñadora de interiores Reilly se encuentra en la ciudad de Mistletoe Lake sin un lugar donde quedarse en Navidad. Ella acepta una oferta de Ray para quedarse en su bote y lo ayuda a renovarlo para el festival naivdeño de la ciudad.

programme.title: La estrella de Navidad
programme.desc: Tras vivir un escándalo, una famosa se dirige a un lujoso resort de Vermont para pasar la Navidad. Al llegar, un error en la reserva la lleva a un pintoresco B&B propiedad de un profesor de astronomía.

programme.title: Christmas in Vienna
programme.desc: Jess, una concertista de violín que ha perdido su pasión, visita Viena en Navidad. Allí encuentra la inspiración que le faltaba, junto a un diplomático estadounidense y sus hijos.

programme.title: Holiday Mismatch
programme.desc: Barb, recién jubilada, se une a un comité navideño, pero choca con Kath, una integrante de larga trayectoria. Cuando se dan cuenta de que sus hijos han empezado a salir, conspiran para romper a la feliz pareja.

programme.title: La Navidad más dulce
programme.desc: Una chef pastelera está emocionada de haber llegado a la final de una competición, pero distracciones en su vida amorosa amenazan con llevar abajo su sueño de ganar el gran premio.

programme.title: Navidad a todo color
programme.desc: Un maestro de escuela primaria daltónico conoce a una optometrista que lo ayuda a traer color a su vida durante las fiestas.

programme.title: Un brindis de Navidad
programme.desc: Una sofisticada sommelier regresa a su pequeño pueblo por Navidad y debe trabajar con el chef de la taberna local, quien fuera su vecino de la infancia, para crear el mejor banquete navideño que el pueblo haya visto.

programme.title: Testigo de Navidad
programme.desc: Una agente federal debe cuidar a un testigo hasta que testifique ante un jurado justo después de Navidad. Sin embargo, esconderlo de su esposa y de un asesino a sueldo no es tan fácil en una ciudad que se prepara las fiestas.

programme.title: El novio de Navidad de mamá
programme.desc: Emma, una madre soltera, siempre pone a los demás en primer lugar, especialmente a su hija Lily, a quien adoptó sola. Pero cuando la pequeña gana un concurso que le cumplía un deseo de Navidad, la vida de Emma da un vuelco brusco.

programme.title: El hermano de Santa
programme.desc: El poco conocido hermano mayor de Santa Claus, Fred, vuelve al Polo Norte, y crea un caos cómico que casi destruye la Navidad antes de demostrar que él no es el perdedor que su hermano menor siempre pensó que era.

programme.title: Navidad sin los suegros
programme.desc: Brad y Kate son una guapa y exitosa pareja de San Francisco que ven cómo sus planes iniciales de pasar el día de Navidad en un lugar exótico, alejados de su ciudad y de sus propias familias, se convierten en algo muy diferente.

programme.title: Atrapado con Papá Noel
programme.desc: Un intruso, quien dice ser el hijo de Santa Claus, irrumpe en la casa de una presentadora de noticias.

programme.title: Hollywood on Set
programme.desc: S1 E1 — La gran muralla / LEGO Batman: la película / ¡Huye!Te mostramos el backstage de las peliculas: La gran muralla, LEGO Batman: la película y ¡Huye! Conoce todos los detalles del detrás de escena, de estos set's de Hollywood.

programme.title: Hollywood on Set
programme.desc: S1 E14 — El regreso de Mary Poppins / La voz de la igualdad / Si la colonia hablaraTe mostramos el detrás de escena de las películas: El regreso de Mary Poppins, la voz de la igualdad y Si la colonia hablara.

programme.title: One Royal Holiday
programme.desc: Cuando Anna ofrece refugio a una madre e hijo varados en una tormenta de nieve, se entera de que son la Familia Real de Galwick. Anna le muestra al príncipe cómo hacen la Navidad en su ciudad natal.

programme.title: Una Navidad para la familia
programme.desc: El hijo adoptivo de Maddy, Wesley, solo tiene un deseo para Navidad: conocer a su hermano Cody, que fue adoptado en una familia diferente. Las circunstancias pronto unen a los dos hermanos.

programme.title: Navidad en Coyote Creek
programme.desc: Una organizadora de eventos descubre la magia de Navidad con un encantador dúo de padre e hijo, durante la organización de una fiesta navideña en el hotel de su familia.

programme.title: Navidad en Londres
programme.desc: David se encuentra en un viaje por Londres en busca del regalo de Navidad perfecto para su novia cuando contrata a Anji para que lo ayude. Sin embargo, inesperadamente, encuentra algo aún más valioso.

programme.title: Navidad en Evergreen
programme.desc: Ali, una veterinaria de Evergreen, planea mudarse a Washington donde vive su novio. Sin embargo, en el aeropuerto conoce a un médico viudo y su pequeña hija. Rápidamente, se sentirá atraída hacia el hombre.

programme.title: El dueto navideño
programme.desc: La talentosa cantante Violette, recién llegada a Nueva York, acepta un trabajo como camarera cantante. Las cosas se complican cuando su compañero de dueto la pone en contacto con un amigo, pero él mismo comienza a sentir interés por ella.

programme.title: Una Navidad para recordar
programme.desc: Si la princesa Colette recibiera un deseo de Navidad, preferiría ser diseñadora de moda que heredera del trono de su país, pero cuando trabaja para el diseñador Wilson James en una colección, encuentra su verdadera vocación y el amor.

programme.title: Una jugada navideña
programme.desc: Alana Higman, una fanática incondicional de los Kansas City Chiefs, y su familia compiten para ganar el concurso Fanático del Año del equipo, en un proceso juzgado por el director de participación de los fanáticos, Derrick.

programme.title: Deseos de Navidad
programme.desc: Semanas antes de Navidad, Abbey es contratada para decorar la finca del empresario Nick. Pero para hacer bien su trabajo, debe descubrir cómo derribar el muro entre ella y Nick, mientras mantiene vivo el espíritu navideño.

programme.title: La Navidad perfecta
programme.desc: Una pareja de recién casados celebra su primera Navidad. Por esta razón, deciden invitar a sus familias y se aseguran de que no existan problemas, incluso si eso significa ocultar noticias.

programme.title: Reyes Magos y un bebé
programme.desc: Tres hermanos experimentan viajes inesperados de autodescubrimiento y sanación cuando se ven obligados a trabajar juntos para cuidar a un bebé durante las fiestas. Durante el proceso, aprenderán a recomponer su relación como hermanos.

programme.title: Tres hermanos y un niño
programme.desc: Los hermanos Luke, Taylor y Stephan ayudan al hijo de Luke, Thomas, con el musical escolar después de que el director renuncia. Se enfrentan al nuevo novio de su madre, Barbara, y a la dinámica familiar durante la temporada navideña.

programme.title: Las últimas vacaciones
programme.desc: Una empleada, a la cual le han diagnosticado una enfermedad terminal, viaja a Europa, en donde sufre una verdadera metamorfosis sin imaginar que la vida aún le depara una sorpresa.

programme.title: Policías de Chicago
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Una hermosa amistadAtwater se instala en su nuevo rol; Lindsay le pide ayuda a Voight; confrontan a Jin por sus encuentros con Stillwell.

programme.title: Chicago Med
programme.desc: S7 E17 — Si amas a alguien, déjalo en libertadLas bandas rivales traen su guerra a Med; Halstead y Charles trabajan con un paciente adolescente con cáncer cerebral que se niega a recibir tratamiento.

programme.title: Chicago Med
programme.desc: S7 E18 — No juzgues, o serás juzgadoAncher y Asher entran en conflicto por un paciente con estrechos vínculos con Goodwin. Después de que un paciente recibe un disparo durante un robo, Scott y Marcel ayudan con la investigación.

programme.title: La ley y el orden: UVE
programme.desc: S13 E9 — El viajero perdidoEl equipo lucha contra la desconfianza y el prejuicio en todos los frentes cuando investiga el secuestro de un niño romaní que fue visto por última vez cuando regresaba de la escuela.

programme.title: La ley y el orden: UVE
programme.desc: S13 E10 — Caída vertiginosaUn mariscal de campo retirado es arrestado por tener sexo con una prostituta de 14 años, pero puede estar sufriendo de reducción de sus capacidades debido a todas las contusiones recibidas en el campo de juego.

programme.title: Chicago Med
programme.desc: S7 E19 — Como el ave Fénix, renacer de las cenizasWill y Hannah intentan salvar al bebé de una madre sustituta; un antiguo paciente de Lonnie se declara en huelga de hambre.

programme.title: Chicago Med
programme.desc: S7 E20 — Fin del día, puede pasar cualquier cosaDylan ayuda a la hija de un jefe de la mafia. Una abuela llega a Med desesperada por salvar a su nieto.

programme.title: Chicago Fire
programme.desc: S9 E3 — Terapia destructivaUn percance en la escalera aérea en medio de un incendio deja a Mouch conmocionado. Por otro lado, Kidd busca el apoyo de Severide mientras Casey y Brett discuten su futuro.

programme.title: Chicago Fire

programme.desc: S2 E15 — Viajando con AlanDurante un aburrido y lluvioso fin de semana, Charlie convence a Alan de ir con él y Jake a Las Vegas. Pero después de que Alan empaca varias maletas, y todos están listos, Jake se enferma.

programme.title: Dos hombres y medio
programme.desc: S2 E16 — ¿Puede comer carne humana con dientes de madera?Judith toma unas vacaciones y deja a Jake con Alan, pero luego Alan se entera que le están haciendo una auditoria. Con este problema a cuestas, debe dejar a Jake en custodia de Charlie.

programme.title: Dos hombres y medio
programme.desc: S2 E17 — Examen de herniaBerta le enseña a Jake algo sobre la limpieza, mientras que Charlie siente dolor después de un encuentro sexual que salió terriblemente mal.

programme.title: Dos hombres y medio
programme.desc: S2 E18 — Era Mame, mamáCharlie se hace pasar por un homosexual para que Eric, el dueño de la campaña de publicidad, que es homosexual le siga dando cuñas o spots para escribir. Charlie convence a Alan de ir como su pareja a la fiesta de Eric.

programme.title: Dos hombres y medio
programme.desc: S2 E19 — Un ruido bajo y gutural con aleteo de lenguaAlan tiene una cita con Sherri, una mujer que alguna vez salió con Charlie solo para tener sexo con él. A pesar de que ella ya no busca relaciones superficiales, Alan parece no poder olvidar que su hermano y la mujer estuvieron juntos.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: S5 E4 — Caída en espiralLa relación de Johnny y Carmen va viento en popa mientras las artimañas de Terry sacuden a Daniel y Amanda. La riña entre los adolescentes continúa en el parque acuático.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Jack Reacher, un antiguo policía militar que vive como un vagabundo y que trabaja por su cuenta, decide investigar el caso de un francotirador que ha sido acusado de matar a cinco personas en un tiroteo.

programme.title: El robo del siglo
programme.desc: Hasta ahora, los ingleses nunca habían hablado de las causas que hicieron del robo al Banco Baker Street, un caso no resuelto, lleno de sexo y corrupción ligado a la familia real. Esta es la historia.

programme.title: ¿Qué pasó ayer? - Parte III
programme.desc: Tras la inesperada muerte de su padre, Alan es llevado por sus amigos Phil, Stu y Doug a un centro especializado para que mejore. Esta vez no hay boda ni fiesta de despedida ¿Qué puede ir mal?

programme.title: Harry Potter y la cámara secreta
programme.desc: Harry ya quiere abandonar la casa de sus tíos, pero inesperadamente se presenta Dobby, un elfo doméstico que le anuncia que correrá un gran peligro si vuelve a Hogwarts. La tranquilidad de Harry desaparecerá cuando llegué a la escuela.

programme.title: The Flash
programme.desc: AcciónSigue las aventuras de Barry Allen, un científico de la policía de Central City con corazón de héroe y un deseo genuino por ayudar a los demás, que, luego del asesinato de su madre cuando era un niño, fue recogido por el detective West.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: S12 E11 — La dispersión del paintballPenny y Leonard organizan un juego de paintball que acaba siendo un caos, cuando Sheldon siente celos de Amy, Raj sorprende a Anu con su ex, y Stuart no se quiere mudar con Denise.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: S12 E12 — La proposición de la propagaciónEl exnovio de Penny, Zack, y su esposa quieren un bebé, pero resulta que Zack es infértil, así que le piden ayuda a Leonard. Además, Koothrappali intenta arreglar las cosas con su exnovia, Anu.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: S12 E13 — La polarización de la confirmaciónUn equipo rival de físicos intenta atribuirse el mérito de la teoría de la superasimetría de Sheldon y Amy.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: S12 E14 — La manifestación del meteoritoA Sheldon le emociona poder ayudar a Howard y Bernadette con todos los trámites burocráticos, ¡hasta que descubre que están quebrantando la ley!

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: S12 E15 — La oscilación de la donaciónLeonard pretende donar su esperma al exnovio de Penny, pero ella trata de evitarlo. En tanto, Wolowitz, Bernadette, Anu y Koothrappali convierten la fallida despedida de soltero de Raj en un viaje de parejas lleno de sorpresas.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: S12 E16 — Dragones y mazmorrasLos chicos intentan irrumpir en el juego de celebridades de Dungeons & Dragons que Wil Wheaton ha organizado.

programme.title: The Pitt
programme.desc: S1 E13 — 7:00 P.M. #1.13Robby inicia el turno de noche y el recuento de muertes aumenta, pero está decidido a salvar a una víctima de un desastre a gran escala, pese a la intervención de Abbott.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: S2 E9 — PulpoJohnny intenta con cautela el amor, mientras que Daniel y Amanda disfrutan de una cita romántica. Un intento de reunir a los estudiantes de los dos dojos fracasa a medida que aumentan las hostilidades entre los adolescentes.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: S2 E10 — Sin piedadLas tensiones entre los dos dojos finalmente llegaron a un punto crítico el primer día de clases. El enfrentamiento resultante deja a un estudiante luchando por su vida.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: S12 E17 — La evaluación de la conferenciaPenny y Bernadette van a San Diego para una convención de ventas de productos farmacéuticos, dejando a Wolowitz a cargo de los niños.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: S12 E18 — La acumulación de premiadosCuando los competidores, Pemberton y Campbell, fascinan a Estados Unidos durante un tour publicitario, Sheldon y Amy intentan ganarles a los laureados por el Nobel.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: S12 E19 — La privación de la inspiraciónEl no saber lo que significaría para las mujeres de todo el mundo el que Amy gane el premio Nobel hace que Amy se derrumbe. Además, Koothrappali y Howard tratan de revivir buenos viejos tiempos.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: S12 E20 — La reverberación de la decisiónKoothrappali está preocupado de que sus colegas y la gente no lo tomen en serio luego de publicar un artículo que sugiere que podría haber descubierto vida extraterrestre.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: S12 E21 — El cisma del plagioCuando Barry Kripke encuentra pruebas de que el Dr. Pemberton plagió su tesis en la universidad, Sheldon y Amy tratan de dar el máximo en su búsqueda del Premio Nobel.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: S12 E22 — La conclusión maternalLeonard se sorprende gratamente cuando Beverly viene de visita y ella es genuinamente amable con él, hasta que descubre la verdadera razón por la que está allí.

programme.title: Dos hombres y medio
programme.desc: S2 E20 — Siempre quise un mono afeitadoEvelyn hostiga a Charlie por no llamarle y Judith le cobra a Alan por un par de costosos zapatos deportivos que le compró a Jake.

programme.title: Dos hombres y medio
programme.desc: S2 E21 — Un hombro en quien llorarMientras revisa los obituarios buscando propiedades potenciales, Evelyn descubre que su segundo marido, Harry, ha muerto.

programme.title: Dos hombres y medio
programme.desc: S2 E22 — Mi madre es una bolsa de papasCuando Evelyn le hace un préstamo a Alan para que pueda comprar un Porsche nuevo, Charlie le informa a su hermano que le ha vendido su alma al Diablo. Evelyn demuestra que Charlie tiene razón cuando obliga a Alan a salir en una cita doble.

programme.title: Dos hombres y medio
programme.desc: S2 E23 — Pichón, pichón, pichón, pichónCuando Evelyn descubre que Jake pasó todas sus vacaciones de verano con sus otros abuelos, presiona a Alan para que deje a su hijo quedarse con ella por una noche.

programme.title: Dos hombres y medio
programme.desc: S2 E24 — ¿Te huele raro eso?Charlie tiene relaciones sexuales con Natalie, una hermosa y joven mujer que sin su conocimiento esta casada con Norman, un hombre mayor.

programme.title: Dos hombres y medio
programme.desc: S3 E1 — El accidente de AlanLuego de la caída de Alan, Charlie tiene que cuidar al adolescente y cada vez más odioso Jake durante el fin de semana.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: S5 E5 — Medidas extremasDaniel confía en un amigo y en un amienemigo. La tensión aumenta para Miguel y Robby. Regresa una cara conocida.

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: Matilda no es una niña corriente: inteligente y sensible, con poderes extraordinarios, debe soportar a unos padres tontos y egoístas. Cuando la niña conoce a una maestra que la valora, la Srta. Honey, su vida empieza a tener otro color.

programme.title: Karate Kid
programme.desc: La historia de Dre, un joven que se muda a China con su madre. Cuando un matón empieza a molestarlo, el chico encontrará a Mr. Han, un hombre que se ofrece a enseñarle artes marciales para defenderse.

programme.title: Harry Potter y la piedra filosofal
programme.desc: En su undécimo cumpleaños, el pequeño Harry Potter, huérfano criado por sus despiadados tíos, recibe un peculiar regalo: la invitación a estudiar en Hogwarts, una prestigiosa escuela de hechicería.

programme.desc: Barbie vive en Barbieland donde todo es ideal y lleno de música y color. Sin embargo, cuando comienza a plantearse cuestiones incómodas, decide conocer el mundo real. El CEO de Mattel hará todo lo posible para impedirlo.
